server.name: server
server.help: Primary TACACS+ server CN domain name or IP address.

secondary-server.name: secondary-server
secondary-server.help: Secondary TACACS+ server CN domain name or IP address.

tertiary-server.name: tertiary-server
tertiary-server.help: Tertiary TACACS+ server CN domain name or IP address.

port.name: port
port.help: Port number of the TACACS+ server.

key.name: key
key.help: Key to access the primary server.

secondary-key.name: secondary-key
secondary-key.help: Key to access the secondary server.

tertiary-key.name: tertiary-key
tertiary-key.help: Key to access the tertiary server.

status-ttl.name: status-ttl
status-ttl.help: Time for which server reachability is cached so that when a server is unreachable, it will not be retried for at least this period of time (0 = cache disabled, default = 300).

options.name: auto
options.help: Use PAP, MSCHAP, and CHAP (in that order).

source-ip.name: source-ip
source-ip.help: Source IP address for communications to TACACS+ server.

interface-select-method.name: interface-select-method
interface-select-method.help: Specify how to select outgoing interface to reach server.

options.name: sdwan
options.help: Set outgoing interface by SD-WAN or policy routing rules.

interface.name: interface
interface.help: Specify outgoing interface to reach server.
